decisions.label: Figure 1
decisions.caption: Overview of 3DCodeBench. (Top Left) Generating 3D via procedural code. (Bottom Left) 212 classes. (Top Right) Visual comparisons. (Bottom Right) 3DCodeArena Elo.
decisions.reason: 概括整体基准架构与评测全景，包含多模态提示、编译沙盒、前沿模型对比与竞技场 Elo，极适合置于机制流程起点。

decisions.label: Figure 2
decisions.caption: Agentic data-curation pipeline. Transforming Infinigen factories into standalone Blender Python scripts via Skills Library and Experience Library.
decisions.reason: 详细展示如何通过技能库与经验库将复杂 Infinigen 资产解构成高质量独立 Blender 5.0 脚本，适合置于核心组件与沙盒章节。
decisions.target_section: 核心组件: 3DCodeBench 评测流水线与可执行性沙盒

decisions.label: Figure 3
decisions.caption: 3DCodeBench dataset statistics: (a) semantic word cloud, (b) code line count distribution (mean 531, median 387), (c) file size distribution (mean 20.5 KB).
decisions.reason: 量化展现基准涵盖的 212 个类别、代码长度和文件体积分布，有力支撑任务复杂度论述。

decisions.label: Figure 4
decisions.caption: Automated perception metrics vs. human preference Elo on 12 evaluated VLMs (SigLIP-2 r=0.964, Uni3D r=0.923, DINOv3 rho=0.972, Executability r=0.459).
decisions.reason: 证明自动化指标能够替代昂贵人类偏好的核心证据图，展示 SigLIP-2 与 DINOv3 对人类 Elo 的超高预测能力。
decisions.target_section: 3DCodeArena 人类偏好与 Bradley-Terry Elo 评分机制

decisions.label: Figure 5
decisions.caption: Single-turn ablations: (a,b) thinking budget sweeps across 12 VLMs, (c,d) number of input views N in {1,2,3,4} sweeps.
decisions.reason: 展现思考 token 对轻量模型的收益与前沿模型的饱和现象，以及视角预算的边际收益递减。

decisions.label: Table 1
decisions.caption: Multi-turn error-feedback on 3DCodeBench. Aggregate executability jumps from 0.692 to 0.972 (+27.2 pp) with large penalized metric lifts.
decisions.reason: 多轮执行纠错的核心数据，直观展示 Traceback 反馈对所有模型执行率的强力拉升与惩罚均值收益。

decisions.label: Table 2
decisions.caption: Coding-agent harness on 3DCodeBench text-to-3D. Harness boosts executability to 0.995 but conditional shape metrics remain virtually identical.
decisions.reason: 揭示当前编程智能体 Harness（Claude Code, Codex CLI 等）'能跑但不变美'的关键论据表。
decisions.target_section: 多模态代码生成中的反思迭代与 Agentic 工具链

decisions.label: Figure 6
decisions.caption: Qualitative comparison of Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7, and GPT-5.5 against 3DCodeBench reference on six prompts.
decisions.reason: 最关键的定性网格图，直观展现模型虽然能够成功渲染，但频繁产生碎片化脱节部件与浮空图元的物理常识缺陷。

decisions.label: Figure A.1
decisions.caption: Cost versus human-preference Elo across 10 paid frontier VLMs and Pareto frontier.
decisions.reason: 展示 10 款商业模型的性价比前沿，揭示 Gemini 3.5 Flash 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的性价比优势及 GPT-5.5 的顶级 Elo 表现。

decisions.label: Table A.1
decisions.caption: Main results on 3DCodeBench (212 categories) across 12 frontier models at best thinking level.
decisions.reason: 全文最核心的主基准大表，涵盖全部 12 个模型的执行率、感知相似度、3D 形状指标、Elo 评分及单次查询成本。

decisions.label: Table D.1
decisions.caption: Multi-turn error-feedback retry (T=3) detailed per-track recovery decomposition and penalized delta.
decisions.reason: 包含所有 11 个模型在文本与图像双轨道上的重试恢复明细及实际耗费美金数，极具实证指导价值。

decisions.label: Table D.2
decisions.caption: Visual self-critique loop showing task-asymmetry between Text-to-3D and Image-to-3D tracks.
decisions.reason: 定量支撑'视觉自反思跨任务不对称性'反直觉结论的核心实证表。
decisions.target_section: 多模态代码生成中的反思迭代与 Agentic 工具链

decisions.label: Figure E.3
decisions.caption: 3DCodeArena live head-to-head win-rate matrix.
decisions.reason: 直观展示 12 个模型两两胜率分布与领头羊优势热力图。
decisions.target_section: 3DCodeArena 人类偏好与 Bradley-Terry Elo 评分机制
